capability: Trust only the parts that agree with their neighbours
title: Trust the parts that agree.

hook.picture: Close: a pod hands the whale one long answer line made of cards, all in the same bold ink. One card is cracked inside but looks the same as the others.
hook.words: It sounded sure about all of it.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: It sounded sure about everything. Which parts can I trust?
problem_in_viewer_words.who: anyone reading an AI answer at work

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Pull back: many answer lines, every card in the same bold ink. Three times, every 2 beats, then 1, then half, a cracked card is acted on.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: Sure and right look the same.

stakes.body: You repeat a made-up detail to a client because it sounded as sure as the rest.

solution_hint: Check each part against its neighbours.

metaphor.body: An AI answer is a line of cards. Each card is checked against its neighbours: those that fit go solid, a card that fits nothing stays dashed, and nothing looks sure by default.

steps.picture: The answer line splits into its cards. Between neighbours, dashed joins appear, and each is read both ways.
steps.words: Check each part against its neighbours.

steps.picture: Joins that match turn teal and their cards go solid. A lonely card with no matching neighbour stays dashed and pale.
steps.sound: Unison pairs; one tone left hanging.

steps.picture: Push-in: the cracked card's joins glow copper on both sides. It stays dashed: marked, not removed.
steps.sound: The pair beats on both sides.

steps.picture: The solid teal run of cards gets a label: section.
steps.words: The parts that all fit: a section.
steps.sound: A held chord across the solid run.

real_case.claim: stalks-and-sections lets each node keep its own space (dim 2–16) across four hierarchy planes, shows residuals, and treats only approximate global sections as trusted.

honest_limit.picture: Push to a solid teal run: its cards' source ticks open into a grid of sixty. Most turn teal, some copper. They agreed, yet some sources do not say it.
honest_limit.words: They agreed. Some sources did not.

not_this.body: Agreeing is not the same as true.

ending_pattern.body: The answer line reads at a glance: solid teal where parts fit, one dashed copper gap where the made-up part sits, and the whale steps over it.
ending_pattern.callback: The made-up card the whale acted on in bar 1 is visibly dashed in the same framing, and the whale passes it by.

end_belief.body: Trust what fits its neighbours. Check the rest.
